body_text:
Comparison principle. If $0\leq a_n\leq b_n$ eventually and
$\sum b_n$ converges, then $\sum a_n$ converges. If
$0\leq b_n\leq a_n$ eventually and $\sum b_n$ diverges, then
$\sum a_n$ diverges. The word eventually permits finitely many
exceptional initial terms, which never affect convergence.
